## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you started.

### Install morphon_nbdev in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure morphon_nbdev package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to morphon_nbdev
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub \[repository\]\[repo\]:

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com//morphon.git
```

or from \[conda\]\[conda\]

``` sh
$ conda install -c  morphon_nbdev
```

or from \[pypi\]\[pypi\]

``` sh
$ pip install morphon_nbdev
```
